description: This source file provides utilities for managing and querying cgroup v1 mount points, including functions for finding mount points, handling errors, and retrieving cgroup paths for processes.

classes.name: NotFoundError
classes.description: Custom error type indicating a cgroup mount point was not found.

classes.name: Mount
classes.description: Struct representing a cgroup mount point with associated subsystems.

methods.name: NewNotFoundError
methods.description: Creates a new NotFoundError for a given subsystem.

methods.name: IsNotFound
methods.description: Checks if an error is of type NotFoundError.

methods.name: tryDefaultPath
methods.description: Attempts to find the default cgroup path for a given subsystem.

methods.name: readCgroupMountinfo
methods.description: Reads and caches cgroup v1 mount information.

methods.name: FindCgroupMountpoint
methods.description: Finds the mount point for a cgroup subsystem, or returns an error if not found.

methods.name: FindCgroupMountpointAndRoot
methods.description: Finds the mount point and root directory for a cgroup subsystem.

methods.name: GetOwnCgroup
methods.description: Returns the relative cgroup path for the current process for a given subsystem.

methods.name: GetOwnCgroupPath
methods.description: Returns the absolute cgroup path for the current process for a given subsystem.
